propositions: src/rebar/signing.py is 800 LOC at the hard cap with zero headroom, blocking any new changes

The monkeypatch on _baked_commit_sha in test_attestation_signing.py becomes a no-op when the symbol moves to _signing_manifest.py, causing test 164 to pass vacuously without testing the live-over-baked precedence it was designed to verify

Splitting signing.py into _signing_manifest.py (manifest vocabulary + gate provenance), _signing_hmac.py (symmetric HMAC scheme), and signing.py (dispatch + CLI arms) maintains an acyclic import graph and keeps all three files within the 200-500 LOC target band

Six private names (_gate_commit_sha, _baked_commit_sha, _NO_KEY, _generate_key_file, _canonical_payload, _hmac_opcert_not_certified) must be re-exported despite underscores to maintain the rebar.signing reuse surface and pass test_reuse_surface_doc.py

The three _baked_commit_sha monkeypatches must be re-anchored from signing module to rebar._signing_manifest module to ensure they correctly intercept the symbol at its definition point, and the test 164 vacuous-pass risk must be closed by a positive guard test
